## Rules

- Before any network/work mutation, the digest-bound authorization and scope carriers name registry/procurements, request ceiling and window. Both probes use the production HTTP boundary, proxy resolver, request budget and sole TLS trust; never `verify=false`. Artifacts exclude bodies, credentials and signed URLs and bind `authority_sha256`, `scope_sha256` and `git_anchor`. A1 records page sequence, source timestamps, boundary-day rows and stop reasons; B2 follows the D8 reducer exactly: same uid/different hash OR no/insufficient replacement evidence → bounded revalidation mandatory; only observed changed-uid replacement set allows pilot defer with explicit limitation. If revalidation is built, it has one bounded selector, honors removal/backoff/lease and routes changed bytes through normal P3.2 finalization/version lifecycle. Raw JSON → factual finding → `@plan/knowledge/research-P4-live-verdict.json`; every successor carries predecessor SHA-256. RAG:— (repo-grounded: D8/D11, P1.1, P3.2).

## Guidance

Add fake-HTTP command tests and sanitized artifact schema tests before live use. A1 live form: `docker compose --project-name agelto_dev exec -T app php artisan crawler:verify-fresh-boundary --input=plans/2026.09.10-№1-PARSING-PRODUCTION-REMEDIATION/artifacts/P4-live-scope.json --output=plans/2026.09.10-№1-PARSING-PRODUCTION-REMEDIATION/artifacts/P4-a1-live-verification.json --no-interaction`. B2 live form: `docker compose --project-name agelto_dev exec -T app php artisan crawler:verify-document-uid --input=plans/2026.09.10-№1-PARSING-PRODUCTION-REMEDIATION/artifacts/P4-live-scope.json --output=plans/2026.09.10-№1-PARSING-PRODUCTION-REMEDIATION/artifacts/P4-b2-live-verification.json --no-interaction`. No shell loop/curl bypass. Negative regression must call production orchestration, not Downloader directly twice. Branch `changed_uid_observed` leaves conditional files absent and records that fact; branches `same_uid_different_hash`/`insufficient_evidence` require every conditional file and the end-to-end revalidation suite before closure.
